entry.name: jit.fx.repos
entry.description: jit.fx.repos performs cell positioning on an input texture received in its left inlet using the input from a second input texture received in its right Inlet as a spatial map.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output dims to input
attributes.description: Adapt output dims to input (default = 1). When enabled the output dimensions will match the leftmost input dimensions.

attributes.name: amt
attributes.digest: Distortion amount
attributes.description: Distortion amount (default = 1). Controls the intensity of displacement of texture 1 based on texture 2.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: boundmode
attributes.digest: Edges bound mode
attributes.description: Edges bound mode (default = 0). Defines the behavior of the coordinates when they extend beyond the texture's edges after the distortion is applied.Possible values are:0 = clipped.1 = wrapped.

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.digest: Bypass effect processing
attributes.description: Bypass effect processing flag (default = 0). When enabled the input is passed through to the output without processing.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.digest: Select channels for displacement
attributes.description: Select channels for displacement (default = 0 1). Determines which channels of the position map (tex1) are used to calculate the displacement for the distortion effect.
